title: Incident boarding mini-cards and deferred alert wizard prototype
creator: Anika Shah
description:
Problem: On-call engineers and incident responders currently need to jump between dense timeline panels and bulky alert creation flows during a page. This increases mean time to acknowledge and fragments context (runbooks, recent rollouts, cost impact).

Goal: Prototype a compact "mini-card" surface that lives at top of an incident thread and a lightweight, deferred alert-creation wizard that lets responders capture and tune alerts during or immediately after triage without leaving the incident view. The surface should preserve key context (SLO deltas, recent deploy ID, relevant logs link, cost trend sparkline) while minimizing visual noise.

Scope:
- Design mini-cards: compact, single-line summary rows that expand to surface quick actions (ack, add runbook, promote to postmortem).
- Deferred Alert Wizard: a 3-step modal that can be launched from mini-card or keyboard shortcut, allowing "capture now, tune later" flow with prefilled suggestions from incident metadata.
- Analytics contract: track event triggers for capture, publish, and abandonment.
- Accessibility: keyboard-first interactions, screen-reader labels for expanded content, contrast checks for sparklines.
- Handoff artifacts: Figma prototype, PRD in Confluence, accessibility checklist, dev-ready tokens and CSS spec.

Constraints & Trade-offs:
- Keep initial MVP to read-only SLO snapshots and a minimal cost sparkline (no full-cost breakdown in first release).
- Avoid modifying core timeline data model; surface is a UI aggregation layer that references existing endpoints.
- Deferred alerts will initially only support threshold and error-rate conditions (no ML anomaly detectors in MVP).

Success metrics:
- Capture rate: percent of incidents where an alert is created or captured within 15 minutes of incident start (target +20% vs baseline).
- Time to acknowledgement reduction by 10% for on-call users in beta group.
- Proportion of deferred alerts that are converted to published alerts within 7 days (target >40%).

Design notes: See attached prototype for micro-interactions: expand/collapse animation is 160ms with 8px easing; keyboard shortcut is "g then a" when focused in incident thread; form autosaves to draft every 5s.
acceptance_criteria: Mini-cards render in incident header and list views with correct SLO delta and recent deploy tag
Expand state exposes quick actions: Acknowledge, Add runbook, Capture alert, Attach postmortem link
Deferred Alert Wizard opens as modal and pre-populates fields from incident metadata (service, error type, sample log link)
Wizard stores a draft and surfaces Drafts in a dedicated Drafts panel in Console
Keyboard navigation and screen-reader labels verified against accessibility checklist
Analytics events emitted: incident.mini_card.open, incident.mini_card.capture_start, alert.wizard.publish, alert.wizard.abandon
